rule.name: reuse-not-rewrite
rule.text: merge.sh and gate.sh are copied from coq; a diff against the coq file changes only config reads, the record reader and writer, and the ticket pattern.
rule.good: git diff --no-index coq/line/bin/merge.sh pr-flow/bin/merge.sh shows only those hunks.
rule.never: A merge decision written new beside coq's.

rule.name: ci-is-the-gate
rule.text: There is no review gate. A PR merges when the required check ci-ok passed on the head GitHub reports now; gh merges with --match-head-commit; a PR with no ci-ok check is held.
rule.good: A ticket-only PR gets ci-ok from the always-run job and merges.
rule.never: A PR with zero checks treated as green, or a CONFLICTING PR listed as would-merge.

rule.name: post-once
rule.text: merged 200 is posted once per PR and ticket; merge.conflict 409 once per head; blocked 423 once per hold sha.
rule.good: A rerun on a merged PR prints already-merged and posts nothing.
rule.never: One 409 a minute while a worker rebases.

rule.name: hold-fails-closed
rule.text: The hold file existing is the hold, whatever it holds; it is checked before any gh call and again right before the merge.
rule.good: An unreadable hold file still holds, with reason unreadable.
rule.never: A merge onto a red main.

rule.name: retry-bound
rule.text: Every gh call and every post retries up to 3 times with backoff, then one blocked 423 and stop.
rule.good: A gh outage posts one 423, not one per open PR.

rule.name: merge-on-green
rule.text: The merge is a GitHub Action on workflow_run of ci, completed with conclusion success: it finds the open PR whose head is the run's head_sha, refuses CONFLICTING or a moved head, and runs gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit. gh pr merge --auto is never used. A local 60 s sweep is the backstop and the record producer; nothing is typed into a pane.
rule.good: business PR turns green and merges in the same minute with no branch protection.
rule.never: gh pr merge --auto on a repository with no protected branch or allow_auto_merge false.

rule.name: timed
rule.text: Every node runs under claude/workflow/bin/step-time.sh, which posts start and end to line.LINE.time.NODE, stops the node at its timeout, and posts step.slow over budget.
rule.good: The UAT proof reads two timestamps off the bus.
rule.never: A node whose duration is only in a seat's memory.

rule.name: cleanup-order
rule.text: After a merge: remote branch, then slot, then local branch from a detached HEAD; never main or the default branch; no checkout of main.
rule.good: A slot holding a foreign process stays leased and the 423 names it.
rule.never: work-order.sh cleanup run from the merge path.

node.name: smart-ci
node.output: ci-ok green or red on that head

node.name: fix
node.output: ci.failed 422 with failing job and log tail; fix work order to the worker lane, once per head
node.proof: 422 record id and work order id

node.name: merge
node.input: workflow_run of ci completed success on the PR head; the sweep as backstop
node.output: merged 200, or held, or merge.conflict 409, or blocked 423
node.coq: line/bin/merge.sh do_pr; factory/bin/gate.sh same-head; median 475 s from last gate
node.proof: bus time from ci.passed 201 to merged 200

node.name: conflict
node.output: merge.conflict 409 to worker, once per head

node.name: cleanup-and-verify
node.output: branches and slot gone; verified 200, or rejected 422 and the hold file
node.proof: git ls-remote exit 2 for the branch; verified record id
